thread:
aj: Quick sync — planning a rolling deploy of sdk-gateway v2.3 tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Canary plan 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~30m. Need a deploy owner, smoke checklist, and rollback ready. Who can own?

maria: I can own the deploy, available 01:45-03:15 UTC. Will run smoke steps and coordinate rollbacks if needed.

kevin: I can watch logs and routing, will prepare quick alert filters. Also will have the rollback command ready in ops-runbook.

jonathan: Did a quick backcompat run against client v1 shims earlier — no obvious regressions on basic generate/embeddings. Will run a couple more edge-cases during deploy.

maria: smoke steps (I'll run these in order):
```
# smoke checks - run from bastion (prod)
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\"" -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-sdk-gw-v2","input":"smoke test"}'
# expect: 200 and time_total < 1.2s for 95th pct under canary
# also run a short prompt-set from /infra/smoke/prompts.json
```

kevin: I'll add alerts: 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained 3m, error budget burn > 15% in 10m -> paging. Will also watch tokenization complaints in logs.

aj: Great. rollback plan (prepped by kevin): `kubectl rollout undo deployment/sdk-gateway -n prod --to-revision=<previous>` and promote traffic via gateway weight rules. Make sure we have previous image digest pinned.

kevin: I'll push the rollback snippet to the runbook and pin the image digest in the release notes. Also adding a tip: if client 1.x fails, we can route traffic to legacy-proxy until fix.

maria: Proposed timeline: T0=02:00 UTC start canary @10% → wait 10m run smoke. If green promote 50% (02:10) → wait 10m smoke → promote 100% (02:20) → full verification until 02:40.

jonathan: sgtm. I'll run client regression suite at each stage (10%, 50%). Will post quick pass/fail reports in thread.

release-ci: release scheduled: job #rwd-release-224 queued for 2054325600, will trigger automated deploy once approved.

ops-bot: Reminder: please add @oncall-sre to the thread 15m before T0 and set pagerduty escalation policy to "deploy-monitor" during the window.

aj: tagging @maria and @kevin as owners. Maria — can you confirm you'll post pass/fail messages after each smoke stage?

maria: yes — I'll post: "canary 10% PASS" or "canary 10% FAIL" with one-line summary and next-step decision.

kevin: I'll be monitoring logs and will post any anomalies with a short snippet. If rollback is needed, call it in thread and I'll run the undo.

aj: perfect. last check: client comms — product/pm informed? we should post a short note to #integrations and the SDK channel about possible minor breaking changes in header parsing (unlikely).

jonathan: PMs looped, they said "ok" but asked to include migration note if we see any client exceptions.

maria: ok I'll draft a 1-line in #integrations after 02:30 if anything pops up, otherwise will post a success note. :thumbsup:

aj: thanks team — will mark the release as approved. See you in thread during deploy.
